Harper L: quick sync — compact autoscale row for dashboards. Need decisions: min/max inline edit behavior, SLO slider presets vs 1% fine mode, and burst modal copy (explicit CTA + billing note). Diego M: Inline edit should be direct typing with Enter to save, Esc to cancel. Arrow keys nudge by 1, Shift+arrow nudge by 10. If min>max show inline validation and suggest a fix. Sam (FE): Implementation: numeric input with visible +/- steppers (44px hit area). Hide native spin controls. Arrow keys map to step attribute; we'll add long-press acceleration for touch. Priya N: UX copy: prefer full labels "Minimum instances" / "Maximum instances" instead of MIN/MAX. Helper text: "Limits autoscale capacity for this route." Jon (a11y): Accessibility checklist: 1) inputs must have labels (visually hidden OK). 2) steppers need aria-labels like "increase minimum instances". 3) slider must expose aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow and have a visible focus ring. 4) announce validation errors via aria-live polite. Harper L: SLO slider: product leans to default 5% snap, but offer presets (50/75/95) and a Fine toggle for 1% steps. How to surface presets without blowing up row? Diego M: Idea: small chevron popover labeled "Presets" that reveals chips 50/75/95. Clicking a chip sets the slider. Fine toggle inline next to numeric display. Sam (FE): Popover approach works. Ensure popover has aria-expanded and focus returns to trigger. Fine toggle will be a button with aria-pressed and step swap logic. Priya N: Microcopy for Fine toggle tooltip: "Switch to 1% precision". Make hit target >=44px and expose a visible label on hover/focus for discoverability. Jon (a11y): Popover must trap focus while open and close on Esc. Announce when a preset is applied: aria-live polite — "SLO set to 95%". Also ensure color contrast for chips/badges meets AA. Harper L: Burst modal: current phrase "Enable burst" too vague. Draft: "Enable burst: +{n} GPUs for up to {t} minutes. Billed while active." CTA: "Enable burst (+{n}, {t}m)". Secondary: "Don't enable". Thoughts? Diego M: Add an auto-revert option: checkbox "Auto-revert after burst period" with tooltip explaining cooldown. Also show estimated cost if available: "Estimated cost: ~$X/hour". Sam (FE): CTA should be explicit (avoid "Confirm"). We'll surface cost inline and a small link "How burst billing works". Modal must trap focus and be dismissible with Esc. Jon (a11y): Modal a11y: trap focus, Esc closes, primary CTA focused by default, aria-describedby points to billing details, cost estimate should be role=status so it's announced after calculation. Focus order should be logical (billing text before CTA). Priya N: Preemptible pool badge: users confused by "preemptible". Suggest label: "Spot (may be interrupted)" with tooltip "Spot instances can be reclaimed; choose a dedicated pool for strict SLOs." If pool is unavailable show reason text and a "Request access" link when applicable. Sam (FE): We'll render disabled pools with 50% opacity + info icon. On selection attempt show role=alert message: "This pool is not available for this project." Also add green "Recommended" cue for low-latency pools. Harper L: Edge cases: if user types min>max, show inline error: "Minimum cannot exceed maximum" and a suggestion button "Set max to X". Prevent save until resolved. Diego M: Backend note: pool API returns reason_code and requestable boolean. UI should render those directly — no extra API changes needed. Cost estimate available from billing API; may be eventual consistency. Sam (FE): I'll prototype numeric inputs + presets popover + burst modal. Will include keyboard flows and accessible markup. Jon (a11y): I'll provide a small pasteable aria checklist and sample markup for slider and modal. Priya N: I'll finalize microcopy variants and a short copy file we can plug into the prototype. Keep wording concise for tight rows. prototype-bot: Prototype uploaded: https://redwood.design/figma/compact-autoscale-v5 (uploaded by Harper L) :white_check_mark: Harper L: Action items: Sam — prototype by EOD Thu; Jon — aria checklist; Priya — final copy file; Diego — confirm cost freshness constraints. Closing thread after prototype review. Thanks all :rocket: Sam (FE): Ack. I'll post the prototype link and keyboard walkthrough when ready. Jon (a11y): Quick aria example for the slider to start:
Priya N: small nit — in modal CTA use plural units nicely: "Enable burst (+4 GPUs, 30m)" not "Enable burst (+4 GPU, 30m)". Harper L: noted. Closing thread once prototype comments are in.
